name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
details: PM-KISAN is a central sector scheme with 100% funding from Government of India. Under the scheme an income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments is provided to all landholding farmer families across the country.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names are eligible. Available throughout India. Institutional landholders, farmers holding constitutional posts, and serving or retired government officers/employees are excluded. No specific age limit.
benefits: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per annum paid in three 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each directly into the bank accounts of beneficiaries.
Aadhaar-seeded direct benefit transfer (DBT) ensuring zero leakage.
documentsRequired: Land Ownership Documents / Record of Rights (RoR)
applicationProcess: Farmers can register online at the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) under Farmers Corner or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or local Patwari/Revenue officer.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
details: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) provides loans up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises. Loans are given by Commercial Banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, MFIs and NBFCs under three categories: Shishu, Kishore and Tarun.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen who has a business plan for a non-farm sector income generating activity such as manufacturing, processing, trading or service sector. Applicant must be 18 years or above and up to 65 years. Available throughout India. Must not be a defaulter to any financial institution.
benefits: Shishu: Loans up to ₹50,000 for early stage businesses.
Kishore: Loans from ₹50,001 to ₹5,00,000 for expanding units.
Tarun: Loans from ₹5,00,001 to ₹10,00,000 for established enterprises.
Collateral-free credit covered by Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU).
documentsRequired: Quotation of machinery/items to be purchased
applicationProcess: Eligible borrowers can apply directly at any commercial bank, regional rural bank or online through the UdyamiMitra portal (udyamimitra.in).

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
details: The Centrally Sponsored Scheme 'National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)' awards scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop out at class VIII and encourage them to continue study at secondary stage.
eligibility: Students studying in Class IX in State Government, Government-aided and local body schools. Minimum 55% marks in Class VII examination (50% for SC/ST). Annual family income should not exceed ₹3.5 lakh. Age between 13 and 16 years. All India coverage.
benefits: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) for selected students from Class IX to Class XII.
Disbursement through Public Financial Management System (PFMS) via DBT mode.
applicationProcess: Online application through National Scholarship Portal (NSP - scholarships.gov.in) upon qualifying the state-level MAT and SAT selection test.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
details: PMEGP is a major credit-linked subsidy programme aimed at generating self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in the non-farm sector by helping traditional artisans and unemployed youth.
eligibility: Any individual above 18 years of age. Minimum 8th standard pass for project cost above ₹10 lakh in manufacturing and ₹5 lakh in service sector. Pan India coverage. No income ceiling. Self Help Groups and cooperative societies are also eligible.
benefits: Subsidy of 15% to 35% on project cost depending on area (Urban/Rural) and category (General/Special).
Maximum project cost admissible is ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for service sector.
Beneficiary contribution is only 5% to 10% of total project cost.
applicationProcess: Applications are accepted 100% online through KVIC PMEGP e-Portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal).

name: Stand Up India Scheme
details: Stand Up India Scheme facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
eligibility: SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneurs. Applicant must be 18 years or above. Greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities or the trading sector. In non-individual enterprises, 51% shareholding must be held by SC/ST or woman. Available throughout India.
benefits: Composite bank loan between ₹10 lakh and ₹100 lakh to meet term loan and working capital requirements.
Repayable in 7 years with a maximum moratorium period of 18 months.
applicationProcess: Online via the Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in) or directly through scheduled commercial bank branches.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
details: Centrally sponsored scheme that provides financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their higher education.
eligibility: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC). Must be studying post-matriculation (Class 11 and above up to PhD). Annual family income should not exceed ₹2.5 lakh from all sources. Available throughout India.
benefits: Full compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursed directly to student bank account.
Academic allowance ranging from ₹2,500 to ₹13,500 per year based on course group and hosteller/day scholar status.
documentsRequired: Caste Certificate issued by designated authority
Income Certificate verifying annual income <= ₹2.5 Lakh
Aadhaar Card and Linked Bank Account
applicationProcess: Apply online through State Scholarship Portals or National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
details: PMAY-G aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and households living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas.
eligibility: Rural households identified through SECC 2011 and Awaas+ survey list. Families with no pucca house anywhere in India. Homeless families, SC/ST, manual scavengers, and destitute households are prioritized. All India rural areas.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plains and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas for house construction.
90 to 95 days of unskilled labor wages under MGNREGS (approx. ₹20,000).
Assistance of ₹12,000 for toilet construction under Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin.
documentsRequired: Land possession proof or certificate of homelessness
applicationProcess: Beneficiaries are selected by Gram Sabha from the Awaas+ list. Registration is completed by the Gram Panchayat through AwaasSoft portal.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
details: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest government-funded healthcare assurance scheme. It provides health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
eligibility: Rural and urban families identified based on deprivation criteria under SECC 2011 and active RSBY cardholders. No restrictions on family size, age, or gender. Recently expanded to all senior citizens aged 70 years and above irrespective of income.
benefits: Cashless and paperless access to healthcare services up to ₹5 lakh per family per year across empaneled public and private hospitals.
Covers pre-existing diseases from day one and 3 days pre-hospitalization and 15 days post-hospitalization expenses.
documentsRequired: Active Mobile Number linked with Aadhaar
applicationProcess: Check eligibility at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or visit the nearest Empaneled Health Care Provider (EHCP) or Ayushman Mitra at public hospitals to generate the Ayushman Card.

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
details: CGTMSE was set up to make available collateral-free credit to micro and small enterprises. Both existing and new enterprises are eligible to be covered under the scheme.
eligibility: New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises engaged in manufacturing or service activities. Maximum credit facility up to ₹500 lakh (₹5 Crore). Available throughout India. Retail trade is also eligible.
benefits: Credit guarantee coverage up to 85% for micro enterprises up to ₹5 lakh.
Guarantee coverage up to 75% for loans up to ₹5 Crore (85% for women and MSEs located in NER/UTs).
Enables first-generation entrepreneurs to obtain collateral-free loans from Member Lending Institutions (MLIs).
applicationProcess: Borrowers approach any scheduled commercial bank or eligible MLI. The bank sanctions the credit facility and applies for guarantee coverage to CGTMSE.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Department of Posts / Ministry of Finance
details: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is a small deposit scheme backed by Government of India launched under the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign to meet the education and marriage expenses of girl children.
eligibility: Girl child who is an Indian resident. Account can be opened from the birth of the girl child up to 10 years of age. Maximum two girl children per family (three in case of twins/triplets). Available throughout India.
benefits: High government-backed interest rate (currently 8.2% per annum compounded annually).
Tax exemption under Section 80C of IT Act (EEE status - investment, interest, and maturity are all tax-free).
Deposit from minimum ₹250 up to ₹1,50,000 per financial year.
documentsRequired: Aadhaar Card and Identity Proof of Parent/Guardian
applicationProcess: Account can be opened at any Post Office or authorized branches of commercial banks by submitting the SSY account opening form.

name: Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS) for Educational Loans
details: Under CSIS, full interest subsidy is provided during the moratorium period on educational loans availed by students from economically weaker sections for pursuing professional/technical courses in India.
eligibility: Students enrolled in recognized technical and professional higher education courses in India. Annual family income should not exceed ₹4.5 lakh. Applicable for education loans up to ₹7.5 lakh under IBA Model Loan Scheme.
benefits: 100% interest subsidy during the moratorium period (Course period + 1 year after completion of course).
Reduces financial burden of interest accumulation during studies.
documentsRequired: Income Certificate from designated state revenue authority
Loan Sanction Letter from Scheduled Bank
Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Account
applicationProcess: Students apply for education loan through Vidya Lakshmi Portal (vidyalakshmi.co.in) and indicate eligibility for CSIS subsidy.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
department: Ministry of MSME and Ministry of Skill Development
details: PM Vishwakarma is a holistic central sector scheme that provides end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople engaged in 18 identified trades including carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, cobblers, and sculptors.
eligibility: Traditional artisans and craftspeople engaged in one of the 18 specified trades. Minimum age 18 years on date of registration. One member per family. Should not have availed credit under similar central schemes like PMEGP or Mudra in past 5 years.
benefits: Recognition as Vishwakarma through PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID card.
Skill verification followed by 5-7 days basic training with ₹500/day stipend.
Modern Toolkit incentive of ₹15,000 as e-vouchers.
Collateral-free enterprise development loan up to ₹1 lakh (1st tranche) and ₹2 lakh (2nd tranche) at concessional 5% interest rate.
applicationProcess: Artisans must register at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) on pmvishwakarma.gov.in with biometric authentication.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Department of Women and Child Development
details: PMMVY is a Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scheme providing conditional cash incentives to pregnant women and lactating mothers for improved health-seeking behavior and partial compensation for wage loss.
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for the first child and second girl child. Minimum age 19 years. Women in regular employment with Central or State Governments or PSUs are excluded. Annual family income below ₹8 lakh.
benefits: Cash incentive of ₹5,000 in two installments for the first child (₹3,000 on registration & antenatal checkup, ₹2,000 on child birth & vaccination).
Incentive of ₹6,000 in a single installment on birth of a second girl child to promote child sex ratio.
documentsRequired: Aadhaar Card of Mother and Husband
Bank Account Details of Mother linked with Aadhaar
applicationProcess: Register online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in or offline through the nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or approved health facility.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
details: Atal Pension Yojana is a guaranteed pension scheme for citizens of India primarily focused on unorganized sector workers. It provides a guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month starting at age 60.
eligibility: Any citizen of India between 18 and 40 years of age. Must have a savings bank account or post office savings account. Non-income taxpayers only (income taxpayers are ineligible to join). All India coverage.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000 or ₹5,000 per month from age 60 until death.
Same pension to spouse after subscriber's death, and return of accumulated corpus to nominee.
applicationProcess: Apply online through Net Banking / Mobile Banking of your bank or visit the bank branch with Aadhaar to fill out the APY registration form.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
details: NAPS aims to promote apprenticeship training and to increase the engagement of apprentices in establishments by providing financial incentives to employers and stipend support to youth.
eligibility: Candidates must be at least 14 years of age (18 for hazardous industries). Minimum educational qualification as required for the apprentice trade (5th pass, 10th pass, 12th pass, ITI, or Graduate). Pan India.
benefits: Industry-recognized on-the-job training certification.
Government reimburses 25% of prescribed stipend up to ₹1,500 per month per apprentice directly to employers.
Direct DBT stipend paid to apprentices under NAPS-2.
applicationProcess: Register and search for apprenticeship opportunities on the Apprenticeship India portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in).
